title: Accelerating the next phase of AI
summary: OpenAI raises $122 billion in new funding to expand frontier AI globally, invest in next-generation compute, and meet growing demand for ChatGPT, Codex, and enterprise AI.
body: OpenAI raises $122 billion in new funding to expand frontier AI globally, invest in next-generation compute, and meet growing demand for ChatGPT, Codex, and enterprise AI.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布完成1220亿美元的新一轮融资。此次资金将主要用于扩展全球前沿AI研发、投资下一代计算基础设施，并满足ChatGPT、Codex及企业级AI服务日益增长的市场需求，进一步巩固其在行业内的领先地位。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI获得巨额融资将直接影响全球前沿AI模型的研发进度与算力基础设施建设。
